business_scope.primary_industry_name: Online Retail of Desktop 3D Printers and Resin Filaments

meta_jurisdiction_context.jurisdiction_name_en: Egypt (national-level jurisdiction; no separate sub-state company registry)
meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Civil Law (with Islamic Sharia as a primary source of legislation)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Egypt-United States Bilateral Investment Treaty (1986, entered into force 1992)
COMESA Treaty and Common Investment Area (CCIA) obligations

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Law No. 159 of 1981 on Joint-Stock Companies, Partnerships with Limited Liability and Limited Liability Companies, as amended by Law No. 4 of 2009, Law No. 17 of 2015 and Law No. 148 of 2018; Law No. 80 of 2002 on Combating Money Laundering and Terrorism Financing, as amended by Law No. 78 of 2016; Executive Regulations of the Anti-Money Laundering Law issued by Prime Ministerial Decree No. 954 of 2016; GAFI beneficial ownership disclosure circulars and AML/CFT consolidated instructions issued by the Egyptian Money Laundering and Terrorist Financing Combat Unit (EMLTFU).

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized certified copy of valid passport (identity and signature pages) of each shareholder, director and ultimate beneficial owner
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public or recognized competent authority in the respective country of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization (Egyptian Embassy/Consulate in the issuing state; Egypt is not a party to the Hague Apostille Convention)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Incorporation and Certificate of Good Standing (if a shareholder is a corporate entity)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Companies registry or competent corporate registrar in the entity's home jurisdiction
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization through the Egyptian Embassy/Consulate in the jurisdiction of issue

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank reference letter confirming legal existence, good standing, identity of authorized signatories and source of funds
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Relationship banker or licensed financial institution where the investor maintains an account
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarization and Consular Legalization as required by the receiving Egyptian bank/GAFI

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Official Arabic translation of the above foreign-issued documents, prepared by a licensed translator and attested before an Egyptian notary public
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Licensed translator and Egyptian Notary Public
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Egyptian notarial attestation following consular legalization of the underlying foreign document

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Under Law No. 80/2002 and its Executive Regulations, the incorporation agent and the corporate vehicle are obliged to conduct mandatory identity verification of all shareholders, directors and UBOs, with enhanced due diligence for politically exposed persons (PEPs, family members and close associates). Screening must be carried out against the Egypt domestic terrorism-financing list maintained by EMLTFU, the UN Security Council Consolidated List, OFAC SDN List, EU consolidated financial sanctions list, and any lists published by the Central Bank of Egypt. Results must be recorded in the AML/CFT KYC file and retained for at least five years after the end of the business relationship.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: General Authority for Investment and Free Zones (GAFI) Electronic Name Reservation System (official e-services portal: www.gafi.gov.eg)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The corporate name must be approved in Arabic and must appear as the governing name in the memorandum of association. A Latin-alphabet transliteration may be registered for cross-border commerce, but it must faithfully correspond to the Arabic name; arbitrary English-only names are not accepted. Names in foreign characters are permitted only as a supplementary trade alias after approval of the primary Arabic name.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Name reservations are valid for 60 days from approval and are not extendable; if incorporation filings are not submitted within the window, the reservation lapses and a new application must be filed. Upon rejection, the applicant may submit a written appeal to GAFI's Legal Affairs Department within 15 working days, attaching an Arabic name variant and evidence that the rejected name does not conflict with protected words or an existing trademark. The applicant may simultaneously file a new reservation using a different name. GAFI's administrative decision is subject to judicial review before the Egyptian Council of State if the appeal is refused.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A serviced office or executive-managed office with a physical reception, meeting rooms and official mailing address is generally acceptable for this low-risk e-commerce LLC. A pure virtual office or PO-box address is not accepted by GAFI as the registered address because process serving and statutory inspections require a physical location in Egypt.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low (<10% annual probability) for a standard low-risk online retail LLC under ISIC 4791. GAFI and EMLTFU may conduct unannounced on-site inspections only upon specific AML/CFT flags, third-party complaints, or separate regulatory triggers.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Egyptian Companies Law No. 159 of 1981 (as amended), Executive Regulations of the Companies Law, particularly Articles 517-548 governing Limited Liability Companies; Investment Law No. 72 of 2017 and its Executive Regulations, administered through GAFI's One-Stop Shop facilitation.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: General Authority for Investment and Free Zones (GAFI) - Central Department for Company Registration / One-Stop Shop (OSS)
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Statutory Application for Incorporation of a Limited Liability Company (GAFI OSS Form LLC-8) together with the notarized Articles of Association (Aqd Al-Taasis) and bank capital deposit certificate
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital for an LLC; the Articles of Association fix the subscribed capital and quotas. The agreed capital must be paid in cash into a temporary corporate bank account before submission, and the bank's capital deposit certificate must be delivered to GAFI. In-kind contributions require a licensed valuator's report. The company is formed upon GAFI's registration decision.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: By the unanimous vote of the founding quota-holders of [Company], it is RESOLVED that: 1. The subscription of quota capital is approved in the amounts listed in the Articles of Association and the bank capital deposit certificate is ratified. 2. The registered office of the Company is fixed at [address], and the Manager is authorized to execute the lease and complete utility records. 3. The following officers are appointed: [Name] as Managing Manager and [Name] as Financial Officer, each with authority to open bank accounts, file registrations, and represent the Company before GAFI, ETA and the Commercial Registry. This resolution is effective as of adoption.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: GAFI One-Stop Shop (Investor Services Portal), Company Registration Department
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Log in to the GAFI One-Stop Shop investor portal and request name reservation with three proposed Arabic or English trade names in order of priority. GAFI performs availability and compliance screening. Once approved, download the name reservation certificate valid for 60 days. If a proposed name contains 'Egypt', obtain security authority clearance or substitute a different name.
required_dossiers: Founder passport or national ID copies
Signed name reservation application with three alternatives
Power of attorney if using an authorized agent
Preliminary declaration of activity under ISIC 4791
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is rejected, file a new name reservation request with the next alternative and pay the reduced re-filing fee; the refusal notice may be appealed to GAFI Legal Affairs Department within 30 days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Notarization of the Articles of Association and manager consents
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notary Public Office (Katteb Al Adl) or GAFI-authorized notary within the One-Stop Shop building
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Present the Arabic Articles of Association for a Limited Liability Company to the notary. All founders or their attorneys-in-fact must sign personally; the notary verifies identity, legal capacity, share quota allocation and the manager's acceptance. The notary returns certified copies for filing. Foreign founders must attach a sworn translation.
required_dossiers: GAFI name reservation certificate
Founder passport or national ID copies
Notarized draft Articles of Association in Arabic (four originals)
Sworn English or universal translation if foreign founders
Manager consent and disclosure forms signed by proposed managers
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notary identifies a defect, execute a supplementary incorporation addendum before the same notary and resubmit for stamping; no new name reservation is required if the company name remains unchanged.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Capital subscription and bank capital deposit certificate
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Any Central Bank of Egypt licensed commercial bank, corporate account opening desk
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open a temporary corporate bank account in the proposed company name and deposit the subscribed capital from the founders' own bank accounts. The bank will issue a stamped capital deposit certificate showing the account number, amount, and value date. For in-kind contributions, obtain a licensed valuator report before deposition; cash capital remains blocked until GAFI incorporation approval unless released by the bank with GAFI's consent.
required_dossiers: Notarized Articles of Association
GAFI name reservation certificate
Founder identity documents and proof of address
Bank KYC/AML forms including ultimate beneficial ownership questionnaire
Source-of-funds declaration
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank demands further beneficial ownership evidence, provide the ownership cascade and certified ID charts; if the bank refuses the account, select another licensed bank and deposit the same capital amount, then update the capital deposit certificate.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Submission of the incorporation file to GAFI
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: GAFI One-Stop Shop, Central Incorporation Unit
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Complete the online LLC formation application, attach all digital copies, and pay the official registration and publication fee. Afterwards, submit the physical file and certified documents at the GAFI OSS counter. GAFI verifies legal compliance, stamps the Articles, issues the registration decision and registers the company ex officio with the Commercial Registry, Tax Authority and Social Insurance Office. Legal existence begins on the date of GAFI's decision.
required_dossiers: GAFI incorporation application form (LLC-8)
Notarized Articles of Association and certified copy of the notary transcript
Bank capital deposit certificate or in-kind valuation report
Lease contract or title deed for the registered office
Manager identity, residence proof and acceptance form
Power of attorney for the authorized agent
Fee payment receipt
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If an application is queried, GAFI issues a defect sheet; the applicant has 15 calendar days to upload or provide the curing document. In the event of a name/trademark conflict, submit a registered trademark clearance or amend the company name with a notarized supplementary deed before final approval.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Tax registration and VAT certificate at the Egyptian Tax Authority
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Egyptian Tax Authority (ETA) registration office at the GAFI OSS or the local ETA tax office
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After receiving the GAFI registration decision, the manager files the tax registration form to obtain the Tax Card. If expected annual taxable supplies exceed EGP 500,000, file the VAT registration form within 30 days. Both registrations can be completed at the GAFI OSS window without a separate ETA visit in most governorates.
required_dossiers: GAFI incorporation certificate
Commercial registry extract
Manager national ID or passport copy
Bank account details and capital deposit certificate
VAT registration application form
Estimated revenue declaration for ISIC 4791
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Tax Card is delayed, obtain a stamped receipt from the ETA registration window and escalate to the GAFI OSS helpdesk; late VAT registration can be cured by submitting a voluntary registration declaration and paying any assessed penalty.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Commercial registration and e-commerce activity endorsement
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Ministry of Supply and Internal Trade - Commercial Registration Office / GAFI OSS relay
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Use the GAFI OSS to file the commercial registry application designating the retail and online sale of 3D printers, resin filaments and consumables under ISIC 4791. Add the e-commerce activity code and obtain the commercial registration extract. For online sales through Stripe or Shopify Payments, keep the commercial registration document and the e-commerce activity endorsement; these are accepted by payment aggregators as proof of legal operation.
required_dossiers: GAFI registration decision
Tax Card and VAT certificate (if registered)
Name reservation certificate and registered office lease
Manager identity and residence evidence
E-commerce activity declaration with platform names
Commercial registry application form
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the registry rejects ISIC 4791 as unclassified, request a GAFI activity-code clarification letter; if the e-commerce endorsement is pending, continue retail operations offline using the commercial register and provide evidence of the pending application to payment gateways.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Not applicable for pure online retail operations; no industrial operating license is required under the Industrial Licensing Law for non-manufacturing e-commerce. If the company later adds resin refilling or filament extrusion, the Industrial Development Authority (IDA) under the Ministry of Trade and Industry must issue the relevant industrial operating permit.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Commercial Registry entry with ISIC 4791 and E-Commerce Activity Endorsement; no separate statutory retail operating license is required. A warehouse/storage civil defense clearance and an environmental registration are treated as physical prerequisites.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Egyptian Environmental Affairs Agency (EEAA), Ministry of Environment
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category B - Environmental Registration is sufficient for a non-industrial storage and dispatch warehouse handling resin filaments; a full EIA study is not required because there is no manufacturing discharge or large hazardous-waste inventory unless individual site thresholds for hazardous waste (usually 100kg or more) are exceeded.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No industrial wastewater or VOC emission sources are created by this business. Any accidental resin spill or wash-water must meet Egyptian Environmental Law No. 4/1994 effluent parameters (pH 6-9, COD ≤ 100 mg/L, TSS ≤ 60 mg/L). Resin containers, wiping materials and empty cartridges must be collected and disposed of as hazardous waste through an EEAA-licensed contractor if storage exceeds the specified trigger volume.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Civil Defense Certificate from the Ministry of Interior for the registered office/warehouse after inspection of fire extinguishers, evacuation routes, electrical integrity and separated storage of resin containers (flammable/irritant class). For premises above the enforcement threshold, a licensed engineering office must furnish a structural load certificate. Occupational safety registration under Labor Law No. 12/2003 is needed before the first employee reports; social insurance enrollment is carried out through the GAFI OSS or Social Insurance Authority.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Egyptian Tax Authority (ETA / الهيئة المصرية العامة للضرائب), an autonomous authority reporting to the Minister of Finance; official digital portal: https://www.eta.gov.eg/; e-invoicing and e-receipt clearance platform: https://srv-invoicing.eta.gov.eg/; complementary single-window incorporation and investment licensing via the General Authority for Investment and Free Zones (GAFI): https://www.gafi.gov.eg/.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Domestic EG LLC route: (1) incorporate the LLC through GAFI's one-stop shop with notarized Memorandum of Association and obtain the Commercial Registry extract (Sijill Tujari); (2) file the ETA Tax Card application within the statutory post-incorporation window to obtain the corporate Tax Identification Number (TIN); (3) complete VAT registration under Article 78 of Law 67/2016 as amended when annual taxable supplies reach or exceed EGP 500,000, using Form 1 and supporting commercial registration, board resolutions, and identity documents of shareholders and directors; (4) enroll in the ETA mandatory e-invoicing system within the applicable phase window, including procurement of the entity digital signature certificate and ERP/API credential onboarding. Non-resident foreign entity with no Egyptian permanent establishment: apply directly to the ETA for a non-resident VAT/TIN account, appoint a resident tax representative with a formal notarized mandate, and submit equivalent incorporation/tax residency certificates; the tax representative assumes joint liability for issuance, filing, and e-invoicing compliance.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Entity_Level_Taxation — the Egyptian LLC is a standalone juridical person subject to corporate income tax under Income Tax Law 91/2005, with no shareholder pass-through attributes; standard CIT headline rate is 22.5% (reduced to 15% for holders of certain license-type investment status subject to conditions; 32.5% applies to Suez Canal Authority, EGPC, and banks, which are irrelevant to this retail scope); resident juridical persons with Egyptian management and incorporation are taxed on Egyptian-source income under territorial sourcing principles, with foreign-source income of resident LLCs subject to additional provisions of Article 14 as applied in practice; distributions to shareholders are separately taxed, and no consolidation or flow-through regime is available.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Egyptian law contains no check-the-box or hybrid mismatch election. Available statutory elections relevant to a private LLC: (a) Small and Medium Enterprise (SME) income tax regime under Law 152/2020 for annual turnover not exceeding EGP 20 million — irrevocable 5-year election replacing CIT with deemed-profit rates (0.5% of commercial/industrial turnover, 4% of professional services turnover) and cash-basis accounting, capped against actual profit; (b) voluntary VAT registration election for persons with annual taxable supplies of EGP 50,000 or more but below the EGP 500,000 mandatory threshold; (c) choice of filing basis as a VAT small taxpayer with a simplified 5% scheme where expressly available under ETA guidance; (d) no group relief, consolidated filing, or tax-transparency election is permitted; each LLC must file separately as an independent taxable person.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: VAT (Value Added Tax) under Law 67/2016 as amended by Law 3/2023, with executive regulations and ministerial decrees; no separate national GST or sales/use tax applies.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: EGP 500,000 of annual taxable supplies for mandatory VAT registration under Article 78(1) of Law 67/2016; voluntary registration available where annual taxable supplies equal or exceed EGP 50,000; non-resident providers of electronic/digital commerce services are required by ETA practice to register for VAT without a local turnover threshold where Egyptian-source supplies are made.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Mandatory real-time fiscal clearance through the ETA e-invoicing engine under Decree 618/2021 and Tax Procedures Law 38/2022: every VAT-registered seller must issue invoices in the ETA XML/JSON schema, transmit each invoice through certified ERP/API integration to the ETA clearance service before issuance to the buyer, obtain an ETA-registered UUID and validation code, embed a digital stamp/signature issued on the taxpayer's electronic certificate, and send only the cleared invoice to the counterparty; invoices lacking a clearance code are inadmissible as evidence and disallow input VAT recovery. The e-receipt (fiscal receipt) mandate also applies in phases to all retail and B2C sales, covering the online maker-hardware channel. Penalties for non-integration, unauthorized serials, or issuance without clearance range from EGP 50,000 to EGP 2,000,000 per violation, plus VAT evasion sanctions when non-compliance is aimed at tax suppression.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Zero-rating applies under Article 22 of Law 67/2016 to: (1) tangible goods physically exported from Egypt and discharged by Customs, including goods sold online to foreign buyers where each consignment exits through an Egyptian customs port; (2) services supplied by a resident taxpayer directly to a non-resident taxpayer for exclusive use and economic benefit outside Egypt, supported by contracts and evidence of the foreign beneficiary's business — export services must satisfy the statutory 'actual use and exploitation abroad' test and may be restricted where effect is deemed domestic; (3) international transport and freight services; and (4) goods exported under bonded or customs-suspension regimes on proof of final exit. For the online 3D printer retail model, the decisive conditions are physical export, customs declaration, foreign-currency receipt, and the zero-rated e-invoice bearing an ETA validation code; digital deliveries of software or support services must be analyzed separately under the services zero-rating test.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (Bayan Shaka) processed through the NAFEZA single-window system evidencing HS classification, quantity, and physical exit from Egypt
Bill of Lading or Air Waybill proving shipment and foreign destination
Inward Remittance Certificate issued by an Egyptian bank confirming receipt of foreign-currency export proceeds within the Central Bank of Egypt repatriation deadline
Commercial Invoice and packing list matching the declared export consignment
Zero-rated export e-invoice bearing the ETA validation code
Purchase and supplier documentation where input VAT refund is concurrently claimed
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: ETA audit risk for zero-rating claims is elevated: each refund or carry-forward claim requires a matched customs–bank–e-invoicing evidence set, and the ETA may cross-check against NAFEZA, the CBE, and foreign buyer databases. Where zero-rating is reversed for insufficiency or non-export: the 14% VAT is clawed back as an assessment, plus a delay penalty of 1.5% per month or part thereof under VAT Law 67/2016, and input credits are correspondingly disallowed. Fraudulent export documentation or deliberately false declarations trigger (a) evasion sanctions of imprisonment from 1 to 5 years and fines of 3x to 5x the evaded tax under Articles 72–73 of Law 67/2016; (b) customs penalties under Customs Law 207/2020, including fines of up to 50% of the goods value; (c) CBE foreign-exchange non-acceptance and exporter blacklisting measures; and (d) anti-money-laundering scrutiny under Law 80/2022 where falsified trade documents are involved. Taxpayers under investigation lose refund priority and may be barred from future export schedules until all clawback assessments are settled.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Central Bank of Egypt (CBE) is the sole foreign exchange control and monetary authority under Law No. 194 of 2020. The CBE exercises FX administration through its Banking Supervision and Monetary Policy Departments, with delegated authority to all licensed Egyptian commercial banks to execute trade, investment, and profit remittance payments. The General Authority for Investment and Free Zones (GAFI) co-administers direct investment entry records and capital registration.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Egyptian pound is a partially convertible managed-float currency. Current-account transactions, including e-commerce export proceeds, freight, royalties, and technical service fees, are broadly permitted through authorized banks subject to underlying documentation. Capital-account flows, including inbound equity injections and outbound investment liquidation proceeds, require a substantive CBE bank review, a valid underlying investment registration, and a direct investment declaration in the bank's CBE reporting template. Profit remittances by a non-resident shareholder are not automatically blocked, but are treated as outbound capital transactions and require audited accounts, proof that all Egyptian taxes and statutory withholdings have been settled, and a CBE-approved transfer of foreign currency. The CBE prioritises import settlement, debt servicing, and evident trade flows when allocating scarce foreign currency, so unrestricted convertibility is not available; all conversions must be executed at the interbank market rate.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Under the CBE's export receipt regime, all export proceeds realised by an Egyptian-licensed LLC must be collected through an authorized Egyptian bank. For physical exports of desktop 3D printers, resin, and consumables, the proceeds must be remitted into the exporter's Egyptian foreign-currency account within 60 calendar days from the bill-of-lading or e-commerce shipment date. The general statutory position is a mandatory 100% repatriation and surrender of documented export proceeds to Egypt, subject to narrow retention rights where the exporter can demonstrate to the bank an immediate permissible use in foreign currency, such as payment for imported filament, spare parts, or trade finance. Banks apply a deemed conversion ratio of 100% of each invoice for reporting purposes; if the proceeds are not used within the permitted retention period, the bank may require conversion into Egyptian pounds at the prevailing interbank rate. E-commerce digital income from app or downloadable software would be treated similarly and categorised as services exports, requiring the same repatriation fingerprint.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Medium, conditional. An offshore digital EMI may be used only as a card-acquisition sweep account and never as the primary treasury or settlement account. Under Egyptian Fintech Law No. 22 of 2022 and CBE Payment System regulations, any institution that opens an account or handles e-commerce settlement for an Egyptian-domiciled merchant must be licensed by the CBE or act through a CBE-licensed payment aggregator. A foreign EMI cannot lawfully be the direct counterparty for the LLC's e-commerce payouts or FX settlement; it may receive Stripe or Shopify payouts as a technical bridge if proceeds are auto-swept immediately to a CBE-licensed local bank account, and all underlying transactions are reported to the CBE bank. The LLC should avoid retaining overseas funds for longer than the settlement cycle, as delayed repatriation could be treated as disguised export proceeds holding and trigger AML/FX penalties.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: For first-time onboarding, physical presence is mandatory. CBE AML/CFT rules require an in-person interview at the bank's Egypt branch for at least one natural-person director who is an authorized signatory, and for each UBO holding 25% or more of the LLC. Original or notarized copies of passports, Egyptian tax identification cards or foreign tax ID certificates, proof of residential address, commercial registry certificate, tax card, firm articles, board resolution, and source-of-wealth documentation must be presented. Remote online account opening is not generally available for newly formed LLCs; some Tier 1 lenders allow the interview to be completed through video call only if a physical client relationship already exists or the incorporation was made via a local GAFI one-stop shop with bank pre-clearance. A local director or a legalized power-of-attorney holder can support the onboarding, but the foreign ultimate beneficial owner must nevertheless undergo a CBE-compliant customer due diligence interview before trade services are activated.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Mismatch between declared e-commerce activity and payment gateway settlement behaviour, particularly high card-not-present volumes or sudden spikes in monthly turnover inconsistent with a new LLC.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Full 12 to 24 months of Stripe and Shopify Payments settlement statements, merchant descriptor records, card scheme reference numbers, order IDs, payout reports, customer invoice log, domain SSL certificate, shipping and tracking evidence, courier airway bills, customs declarations for physical 3D printers, supplier invoices, and a written business model narrative that reconciles order volume with bank receipts.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Inbound capital injections from a foreign shareholder routed as one-time large-sum remittances without clear economic substance or from loosely documented source-of-funds channels.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Share subscription agreement, LLC articles of incorporation, board resolution authorizing capital contribution, minutes of shareholders' meeting, capital verification report from the receiving bank, foreign bank statement showing the remitter and the originating corporate account, UBO passport and proof of address, declaration of source of wealth, group structure chart, and GAFI/CBE direct-investment declaration forms prepared by the bank.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Frequent or high-value related-party disbursements to China-based resin and consumable suppliers without adequate import documentation or a commercial rationale that matches the bank's transaction profile.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Listed import supply agreement with the China supplier, purchase orders, post-shipment customs import declarations, ACI CargoX system registrations, pro forma invoices, final commercial invoices, packing lists, bills of lading, import duty and VAT payment receipts, HS classification for resin and consumables, transfer-pricing local file or a consolidation memorandum, and a schedule of each outward remittance linked to a discrete import transaction.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Use of personal accounts, family offshore EMI accounts, or third-party payment channels for treasury, payroll, or settlement of trade payables, creating an intentional or inadvertent commingling red flag.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Written treasury policy prohibiting commingling of personal and corporate funds, complete corporate bank statements for every treasury channel, payroll processing through the corporate account with signatory matrix, ledger records of all shareholder loans, audited financial statements or annual management accounts, and a letter of explanation certified by the directors together with any corrective action plan already implemented.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: All inbound equity or shareholder-loan capital must be remitted by SWIFT MT103 or MT202 from the investor's own bank to the Tier 1 CBE-licensed Egyptian bank. The wire instruction must include clear purpose syntax, normally /PURP/INVS/ plus a free-text reference 'DIRECT INVESTMENT IN EGYPTIAN LLC - EG__EG__EG_LLC'. The receiving bank will reconcile the remitter identity, collect a foreign currency / Egyptian pound account number, and demand the LLC's capital increase or initial contribution documents, CR extract, tax card, and board resolution. The bank obtains a CBE direct-investment declaration and a GAFI registration check before crediting the funds to a segregated capital escrow sub-account. Capital escrow funds cannot be debited for operational expenses until the capital verification certificate is issued and the bank allows movement to the operational account. SWIFT gpi is recommended to provide an end-to-end tracker, and all conversion of the received USD or EUR into EGP must be executed at the interbank rate on the receipt date or on the value date selected by the client, with a written conversion instruction and a mirroring CBE record.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: For import settlement of resin, filament, and 3D printer components, the LLC may use the following rails: (a) open-account SWIFT MT103 payment for values generally below USD 50,000 to 100,000, with purpose code 'trade settlement' and the underlying customs import declaration reference included in field 70; (b) irrevocable documentary Commercial Letter of Credit issued via SWIFT MT700, complemented by MT707 amendments, for larger or supplier-required transactions, with beneficiary in the exporting country and documents covering commercial invoice, packing list, full-set original bill of lading or airway bill, certificate of origin, and final quality certificate; and (c) for local EGP obligations, vendor disbursements are cleared through Egypt's real-time gross settlement system and InstaPay rails. The customs authority requires ACI CargoX registration for all physical imports before any bank release of import funds, and the bank will match each outward settlement against the customs declaration, pro forma invoice, and letter of credit terms.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Plain-vanilla onshore EGP/USD and EGP/EUR deliverable forward contracts, with tenors not exceeding 12 months and supported by a real trade receivable or payable approved by the CBE-licensed relationship bank.
FX swaps between EGP and USD/EUR for sweeps of export cash balances into operational EGP liquidity, limited to real working-capital cycles and documented by underlying import/export invoices.

Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) referencing EGP/USD, usable either through offshore bank affiliates or onshore bank hedging desks solely against an identified underlying commercial exposure, with settlement amounts capped at the verified trade value.

Cross-currency swaps between EGP-denominated liabilities and USD/EUR e-commerce revenue streams, subject to CBE bank risk limits, board approval, and evidence of hedging the economic risk rather than creating speculative open positions.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual audited financial statements and auditor's report
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: General Authority for Investment and Free Zones (GAFI)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within three calendar months following the LLC's fiscal year-end (by 31 March for a calendar year-end).
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Fixed late fee applied under the executive regulations of Companies Law No. 159/1981; repeated non-filing may result in administrative strike-off and company deregistration.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within four months after the close of the fiscal year (by 30 April for a calendar year-end).
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: EGP 5,000 fixed penalty plus 2% per month on unpaid tax; enforced collection, interest, and potential criminal liability for deliberate non-filing.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Commercial Registry, Ministry of Trade and Industry
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually during the period from 1 January to 31 March.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Progressive daily fine for late renewal; failure to renew for 90 days or more can lead to suspension and eventual strike-off of the commercial registration.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually before the beginning of the following fiscal year (by 31 December for calendar-year taxpayers).
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Suspension of active tax status, administrative penalty, and inability to obtain tax clearance certificates for bidding, import, or export activities.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: All Egyptian LLCs are required to appoint a certified public accountant as auditor each fiscal year; no threshold based on revenue, assets, or capital exempts the company from this mandate.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Egyptian Accounting Standards (EAS), closely aligned with IFRS; compulsory for all registered limited liability companies.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: No separate annual UBO return is currently required for Egyptian LLCs. The company must maintain current shareholder or member information in its statutory register and update the Commercial Registry within 15 days of any share transfer or ownership change. Beneficial ownership records must be retained and disclosed to the Egyptian Money Laundering and Terrorist Financing Unit upon lawful request.

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 22.5% (20% base corporate income tax plus 2.5% Social Solidarity Surcharge on net profits, Article 51 and related provisions, Law No. 91 of 2005)
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: No sector-specific tax holiday for online hardware retail. Eligible SME under Law No. 8 of 2018 may elect a presumptive tax of 0.5%–1.5% on gross annual turnover up to EGP 20 million, instead of net-profit-based CIT. Investment Law No. 72 of 2017 incentives require a licensed project in a designated zone and are not presumed for this LLC.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Form 516 (Corporate Income Tax Return) e-filed through the Egyptian Tax Authority (ETA) online portal (taadomy/EGTax e-filing module); mandatory e-invoice records linked via the ERGS e-invoicing platform
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Within 4 months following the fiscal year-end; for a calendar-year taxpayer, the deadline is 30 April

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Commercial registration number and entity legal name
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: State the Egyptian LLC name exactly as registered with the Commercial Registry; disclose the ultimate foreign parent in the attached ownership schedule

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Tax Identification Number (TIN) and activity code
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Enter the 9-digit ETA TIN and ISIC activity code 4791 (online retail)
Use the audited financial statement period; all monetary fields in Egyptian Pounds (EGP) unless a specific ETA waiver has been granted
Report all Shopify Payments and Stripe settlements reconciled with e-invoices; export sales and cross-border platform fees must be separately stated

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Cost of goods sold (imported 3D printers, resin filaments, spare parts)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Attach customs declarations and related-party purchase invoices; if purchases are from a non-resident affiliate, a transfer pricing disclosure must be referenced

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Operating expenses: payment gateway fees, hosting, warehousing, fulfillment fees
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Gateway fee deductions must be backed by merchant statements from Stripe/Shopify; related-party service fees require arm's length proof

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Net accounting profit before tax per audited financial statements
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Reconcile the audited income statement to the statutory books; foreign-owned LLCs must attach the locally appointed auditor's report

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Add-back of non-deductible expenses (provisions, entertainment, unregistered consultancy fees)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Include disguised profit distributions, excessive management fees, and penalties; treaty relief does not apply to deductions

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Net taxable income after offset of prior-year tax losses (maximum 5-year carryforward)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Only losses from Egyptian taxable activities may be offset; carryforward schedule must be attached
Apply the statutory rate to net taxable income; no treaty reduction applies to domestic CIT assessment

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Social Solidarity Surcharge at 2.5% where separately computed on net distributable profit
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Verify whether the ETA's tax assessment letter has merged the surcharge into the headline rate; credit available for withholding paid on foreign-source items

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Foreign tax credit (WHT suffered abroad on export royalties or foreign deposits)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Claim only with original certificates of foreign tax withholding and a tax residency certificate (TRC) where applicable

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Advance corporate income tax installments paid during the fiscal year
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident-owned LLCs remain subject to the ETA quarterly advance payment schedule; reconcile with ETA receipts

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Net balance payable to the ETA or refund claimed
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Direct remaining liability only from the Egyptian bank account of the LLC; payment must be executed before the deadline to avoid delay surcharges

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Failure to file Form 516 on time: fixed administrative fine of up to EGP 50,000 plus a monthly late-payment surcharge of 3% on unpaid tax (pro-rated daily for partial months, capped at 24% of the tax due) under Law No. 86 of 2022; continued failure triggers automatic ETA default assessment. Filing a knowingly false return is criminal tax evasion under Article 133 of Law No. 91 of 2005, carrying imprisonment and fines.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 10% on distributions made to non-resident shareholders (Article 56, Law No. 91 of 2005); no Egyptian dividend WHT is levied where the recipient is an Egyptian resident company and the dividend has already borne corporate income tax
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: To invoke a reduced DTA rate, the non-resident shareholder must obtain a Tax Residency Certificate (TRC) issued by its home tax authority covering the distribution year. The LLC submits the TRC, board dividend resolution, ownership/beneficial-ownership declaration, and audited undistributed-reserve computation to the ETA International Taxation Administration before the payment date. The ETA issues a formal approval of the treaty rate; payment made without prior approval must be withheld at 10%, with the non-resident eligible to file a reconciliation/refund application with the ETA after year-end.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Royalties for IP use: 20% statutory withholding; DTA-protected rates commonly 10%–12.5%. Interest on shareholder or third-party debt: 20% statutory withholding; treaty reduction typically to 10%–20%, and an Article 57 exemption applies to interest on foreign loans approved by the Central Bank of Egypt (CBE), subject to registration conditions.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Local File mandatory when aggregate annual controlled transactions exceed EGP 16 million; Master File required when the MNE group's consolidated turnover exceeds EGP 250 million; CbC report required when the group's consolidated turnover exceeds EGP 500 million. The ETA also requires a TP disclosure schedule wherever controlled transactions exceed EGP 5 million.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: No standalone Economic Substance Regulations statute as in the UAE; however, Egypt applies substance-over-form and general anti-avoidance rules (GAAR) plus beneficial-ownership tests requiring actual management, premises, staff, and commercial decision-making in Egypt. A letterbox LLC acting solely as an invoicing conduit for non-resident principals is recharacterized, denied treaty benefits, and subject to retroactive assessment and penalties.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Corporate Income Tax Evasion (online revenue suppression)
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Directing Shopify Payments/Stripe settlements to foreign personal accounts, deleting e-commerce transaction records, and failing to issue mandatory e-invoices for retail sales of 3D printers and resin filaments
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Imprisonment of up to 5 years and a fine of at least EGP 5,000 and up to the larger of EGP 50,000 or an amount equal to the evaded tax (Article 133, Law No. 91 of 2005); automatic issuance of a default assessment plus the 3% monthly delay surcharge capped at 24% of the unpaid tax
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and the ultimate foreign beneficial owner are jointly and severally liable for the evaded tax; the Commercial Enforcement Court may impose travel bans and asset freezes on the managers and signatories; criminal imprisonment may be enforced personally against the directing mind

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Importing resin/filaments from the foreign parent at non-arm's length prices, paying unbenchmarked management fees, and failing to prepare and file the Local File or TP disclosure despite controlled transactions exceeding the EGP 16 million local threshold
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Primary TP adjustment of taxable income, recalculation of the CIT at 22.5%, delay surcharge on the additional tax, and an administrative penalty of up to EGP 50,000 under Law No. 86 of 2022; repeated non-compliance triggers an enhanced audit risk across all open years
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who sign inaccurate Form 516 declarations or TP disclosures incur personal fines and may be held jointly liable for the adjusted tax; ETA may pursue their Egyptian personal assets to settle the corporate liability

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operating the Egyptian LLC with no physical premises, no local personnel, and no strategic decision-making while all sales, logistics, and procurement are executed by the non-resident parent, thereby creating a mere conduit for profit stripping
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: ETA recharacterization of the intermediary structure, denial of the DTA claim on dividends, application of the 10% dividend WHT plus additional tax of 20% of the adjusted amount, and criminal referral for false bookkeeping
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Corporate veil piercing permits civil recovery directly against the controlling shareholders and shadow directors; travel bans and seizure of personal bank accounts are available under Egyptian execution law where the entity has no separately realizable capital

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Declaring and remitting dividends to the non-resident shareholder without withholding the 10% statutory tax or without the ETA-approved TRC substantiating a lower DTA rate
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: The LLC remains liable for the unwithheld tax, the 3% monthly delay surcharge (max 24%), and a separate penalty equal to the amount of tax not withheld; no statute of limitation applies where the distribution was made without a declared withholding
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: The directors and the officer who executed the dividend mandate are jointly and severally liable for the uncollected WHT; an asset freeze takes effect automatically upon issuance of a formal ETA notice of deficiency

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Accepting Stripe/Shopify payments from sanctioned jurisdictions, handling virtual-card or third-party funding without beneficial ownership identification, or failing to file a Suspicious Transaction Report (STR) with the Egyptian Money Laundering and Terrorist Financing Combating Unit (EMLCU) when merchant activity does not match the declared online retail business
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Imprisonment and a fine of up to EGP 1,000,000 under Law No. 80 of 2002 (as amended); Stripe and Shopify may terminate the merchant account, and the ETA may revoke the LLC's tax certificate and freeze trade registrations
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who knowingly operate the undisclosed payment structure face personal prosecution, travel bans, confiscation of proceeds, and personal civil restitution to the Egyptian Central Bank's compensation fund
